title: Debut on WDSU TV in New Orleans and Evansville accent story
summary: Paige describes his television debut on WDSU Channel 6 and an Evansville interview about his southern accent.

story.theme_name: Radio and television work: staff jobs, shows and broadcasts

blocks.x: All right, Lee, would you tell a little bit about your debut in TV here in New Orleans?

Yes, when I made my debut was here in New Orleans over WDSU, Channel 6 on Royal Street and the 400 block here in New Orleans. I appeared there for quite some time after making my debut. And at that time, the manager of the station was Live Right, which we call him Mr. X now.
Lee, how about Channel 14 in Evansville where they were... Oh, yes.

...ripping your accent? Well, I was appearing on Channel 6, that's Channel... 14. ...14 in Evansville. And they were interviewing me and they were talking about my southern accent. So they kept going on about it and said, you really have a southern accent? And I said, well, is there any other way to talk?
